title: UTMB Mont-Blanc 2026 — UTMB Spain race guide
claims: The 2026 HOKA UTMB Mont-Blanc week ran from 24 to 30 August 2026, with UTMB, CCC and OCC as the three World Series finals.
For the 2026 CCC lottery, the required UTMB Index race category was 50K, 100K or 100M; for OCC any UTMB Index race category was accepted; every applicant needed at least one Running Stone.
The 2026 pre-registration window was 8–19 January and the lottery was held on 22 January 2026.
The 2026 event expected about 10,000 runners across eight races.
